digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge library and MCP surface
propositions: New typed bridge library functions (bridge_preview, bridge_sync, bridge_status, bridge_pause, bridge_resume, bridge_check_access) must be exported through public library import paths and reuse the shared run_pass() classification seam without duplicating core logic.

Equivalent MCP tools must be registered with explicit typed inputs/outputs and no mode parameter, preserving existing reconcile(mode=...) and bridge_fsck tool contracts while gating mutating routes through mcp.allow_jira_sync.

Legacy rebar.reconcile(mode=...) must retain its subprocess-visible return shape, dry-run default, and accepted mode vocabulary as a compatibility adapter; preview modes must never silently become sync.

Each legacy library and MCP reconcile mode must have identical semantic state and mutation outcome as its mapped new bridge operation, verified through cross-surface disposition tests against real temporary repositories.

New structured-result tools must publish outputSchemas and maintain parity in MCP models, types, and generated reference/schema coverage; existing compatibility schemas remain valid after registration.
Documentation must present noun-based bridge operations as primary while explaining retained legacy entrypoints as supported compatibility without breaking existing automated callers.
